changes.implemented: Removed outputs.soundRequired from the current strict schema and removed its redundant GDD/UI-to-Audio coverage gate. Audio events remain the owned sound definitions with real source references. Existing source-reference and required-resource checks remain active.
changes.limitation: Semantic completeness was never established by a boolean coverage declaration; it remains an independent Review task. Old sidecars with the retired field are explicitly diagnosed, not silently migrated.

changes.implemented: Reused the existing native assignment runner for specialist batches 2–4 in addition to directions. Scene completes before Balance; Asset Plan completes before final Tech; UI has one named fresh writing owner. Each reads original brief, own responsibility and applicable tools from a scoped task file; saved owner documents carry dependencies instead of author transcripts. Directions remain parallel; GDD remains its existing single-document writing turn.
changes.limitation: Dependency ordering sacrifices overlap for coupled drafts. It does not cap tokens within an individual author's session or prove paid savings.

changes.implemented: Supplied spatial help and selected format sections in the applicable scoped inputs; supplied the exact numerical calculation command. Removed duplicate inline responsibility when scoped context already carries it. Author source permission callback rejects observed native-log and bundled checker source-reading probes and replacement author dispatches; allowed operations still pass through original native permissions. Applied the author Bash description after actual native worker tool-pool rebuilding and forced the role callback to be consulted.
changes.limitation: The observed-probe filter is task scoping, not a shell sandbox or a guarantee against all possible obfuscated source reads. Necessary calculations and authoritative evidence collection remain available.

changes.implemented: Executable evidence is requested for consequential derived claims, with scenario execution only for claims that need it. Initial parameters do not require a simulator. Generated counts and static bounds cannot be described as actual executed outcomes.

Compare local and global rules in the same before/event/after situation; match platform evidence preconditions to the actual consumer condition; match numerical quantity, reporting time and action policy to the executed model; establish a real contract violation before accepting a structural revision recommendation. Existing audio writing Skill already defines behavior once and exceptions as explicit overrides, so it was not given another ownership definition.
changes.limitation: These are semantic review methods, not deterministic semantic certification. Ownership remains in the existing agent assignment, not Skill.
